estates.title: Naiveyearly.com
estates.description: A traveling gathering for the web, bringing together artists, designers, and thinkers exploring internet culture, open protocols, and new ways of living.

estates.title: Diagram.website
estates.description: A curated map of over 200 links exploring internet philosophies, independent web culture, and alternative ways of navigating the internet.

estates.title: Naiveweekly.com
estates.description: An independent publication and living archive of the Poetic Web, documenting websites, people, ideas, and creative internet culture since 2018.

estates.title: Tinyawards.net
estates.description: An annual celebration of small, poetic, creative, handmade websites, recognizing independent web projects through public nominations and voting.

estates.title: Mygirlfriendisanartist.com
estates.description: A personal collection of analogue photographs by artist Ana Šantl, accompanied by intimate writing and presented as a love project on the web.

estates.title: Wilderness.land
estates.description: An interactive internet wilderness made from a Google Sheet, inviting visitors to wander through hundreds of websites and discover the unexpected.

estates.title: Internetphonebook.net
estates.description: A printed guide to the poetic web, featuring hundreds of personal websites, essays, and a Dial-a-Site system for exploring the internet.

estates.title: Urlpoetry.club
estates.description: An experiment in found poetry made from website domain names, exploring internet memory, online kinship, and the poetry of web addresses.

estates.title: Postcard.place
estates.description: An offline travel email project exploring correspondence and travel.

estates.title: Apossible.com
estates.description: A non-profit research and design initiative exploring how psychology, design, and technology can support human flourishing, care, and curiosity.
